none: PAS CAM-76CFC9: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy nummus of the House of Theodosius, AD 378-402
contea di ritrovamento: City of Peterborough (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Theodosius, AD 378-402 (Reece period 21). Reverse legend reads [VICTORIA AVGGG]. Reverse shows Victory advancing left, holding wreath and palm. Mint is uncertain, AD 388-402. Obverse legend is illegible. Obverse shows Diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Die axis is 6 o'clock, Weight is 0.81g, diameter is 12.5mm, thickness is 1.4mm
